craft_notes: Sthāyin: svādhyāya-vīra of study-and-making — hermetic couplets, hyphen-pressure; music in pack + terminal words; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (owner verdict required). Foe included (adbhuta of foe-included): school AND foe both made — inclusion without exception. Rejected: (a) softening foe → killed: inclusion is the shock. (b) explaining made → killed. Read aloud: HIS-know-ing, HIS-un-KNOW-ing-TOO … ITS-foe-TOO, OF-him-MADE.

lines: His knowing, His unknowing too — that, of-Him-made;
He, Bhairava's own school — its foe too, of-Him-made.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tad eva bhairavaṃ jñānam ajñānam api yanmayam | sa hi bhairavasiddhāntaḥ pūrvapakṣo 'pi yanmayaḥ

reads_against.argmap: What is Bhairava-doctrine, and its opponent? → Knowledge-ignorance and doctrine-opponent, all made.
